question: Arpit completes a journey in 10 hours. He covers half of the distance at 30 km/h, and the remaining half of the distance at 70 km/h. What is the length of the journey?
solution:
Given:

Total time taken = 10 hours

The car travels half of the distance with a speed of 30 km/hr and other half at a speed of 70 km/hr

Formula used:

Time = Distance/Speed
